easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.

description:
Cast Sceptre of Eternal Glory by paying at most {1} due to Sami.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Sceptre of Eternal Glory from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
